cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your newest club member, I second these minutes. You may record that before we go on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I second your motion. Unanimously. Put that wording down; it covers the matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. You may amend my wording to that. I'll hear her vote before I let us call anything unanimous; we keep our minutes accurate here.

reason: Have the newest member direct recording and then accept B corrected meanings as A accuracy policy, preserving actual adaptation rather than self-serving redefinition.
